manifest.author: Sean Galliher and Cowork Cookbook contributors
manifest.description: Builds an executive business value story for a named customer and product — strategic context, 9 use cases, 2x2 prioritization, pain→outcome map, KPIs, transparent ROI model, and call to action — as a 5-7 slide deck and
manifest.name: @cowork-cookbook/roi_and_value_selling_artifact

details.license_note: Recipe content is CC BY 4.0 (share and adapt with attribution) and code is MIT. RAR carries each recipe's prompt, prerequisites, steps and expected output verbatim with attribution, so the toasted agent runs the real recipe; bundles and screenshots stay upstream.

context.description: Optional. Details the recipe should use — the record, scope, dates or filters it asks for.

customer_and_product.description: Customer name, their website, and the product being positioned, plus three use case categories.

industry_and_personas.description: Customer industry and the primary persona(s) the story targets.

kpis_and_population.description: Confirmed KPIs and the impacted user population.

operation.description: What to do: run, prompt, plan, checklist, describe.

roi_assumptions.description: Fully loaded hourly cost, volume metric, realization factor (default 0.75), license type, and engagement program.

strategic_priorities.description: Known strategic priorities or pain points; left blank, they are researched or labeled as hypotheses.
